name: GoNNoTDa Survey Builder (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted PHP/MySQL survey builder with 16 question types, bilingual surveys, QR sharing and response analytics; no vendor-hosted quota or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Apache/PHP and MySQL/MariaDB hosting, HTTPS, storage, backups and security maintenance; infrastructure is not free. Remove install.php after setup. New upstream project with limited adoption.
